E. Relationship Between Local Short-term Uses of Man's Environment and the Maintenance and Enhancement of Long-term Productivity.
No cumulative or long-term effects which either reduce or enhance the state of the environment are anticipated from this project. As stated in a previous paragraph residual materials will be stored locally in the firn at the project site. This will be a very local effect and will not impair the environmental quality or the scientific value of the contiguous ice shelf.
Areas of possible concern for environmental impact will be monitored throughout the duration of the project; these are described in Table 3.
